text:
tom: FYI we ran the blackout sim in eu-west and hit a keystore endpoint preference issue that delayed GPU node joins.
priya: noticed warm-pool dipped ~25% and onboarding queue jumped at 1733332100. Some pods stuck in Init waiting for KMS decrypt.
ops-bot: alert: keystore.decrypt.timeouts > 50 in 5m window (eu-west)
sam: quick root-cause: endpoint ranking falls back to route_metric then hostname when flowlog health is absent. during the sim many flowlogs stopped briefly and a decommissioned endpoint without recent flowlogs got picked.
priya: that explains it. the decommissioned host had a newer route_metric but no flowlogs, so it looked "closest" by metric.
tom: can we change selection to explicitly reject endpoints without recent flowlogs and prefer high flowlog_count?
sam: yes. short-term patch proposal: require flowlog_age < 300s and flowlog_count >= 5 in last 5m, then rank by [flowlog_count, health_score, latency_ms, route_metric]. fallback to static blacklist for known-decom endpoints.
priya: snippet for agent config:
```yaml
endpoint_selection:
  min_flowlog_freshness_s: 300
  min_flowlog_count_recent: 5
  ranking_order:
    - flowlog_count
    - health_score
    - latency_ms
    - route_metric
  static_blacklist:
    - "keystore-decom-eu-02"
    - "keystore-legacy-eu-1"
```
sam: note: this is purely agent-side; no IAM/KMS policy changes. we will also emit a new diag metric keystore.selection.rejected_flowlog to monitor regressions.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-8124: keystore-selection-flowlog-gating (owner: sam). ETA: canary in 2h.
ops-bot: audit export requested for window 1733332000-1733333300, tag: keystore-blackout-sim.
ops-bot: temporary extra egress during sim routed ~55k decrypts via fallback region (~4.1GB, est $0.14).
tom: assign tasks: sam -> hotfix + canary rollout; priya -> run extended sims with partial flowlog dropout; I'll do the post-fix runbook update and ensure oncall alarm thresholds.
priya: ack, I'll validate sims and add unit tests for selection logic.
sam: ack, will roll canary and post metrics.
ops-bot: marking thread for follow-up in 48h after postmortem.
